column1: # PHASE 1's TEN CONSTRUCTS -> CENSUS KEYS, with both denominators. Board #3509 / lane w-keymap, 2026-08-25.
# NOT A RANKING. Ordered C1..C10 (ROADMAP_SLICING_2026-08-21.md section 5's own order) and, within a
# construct, by key NAME. #3505's rule -- a lane dispatched off a blocked-key size ranking finds the
# ranking was an artifact -- has bound five times. Do not re-sort this file by any count column.
# THE TWO DENOMINATORS ARE DIFFERENT INSTRUMENTS AND MUST NEVER BE SUMMED OR COMPARED AS ONE NUMBER:
#  cf_mass       ROADMAP_SLICING section 3's published body count. It is
#                It COUNTS BODIES THE PORT ALREADY EMITS: 518,956 of the residue is in class.
#  cf_inclass    the in-class half of cf_mass -- bodies this construct 'covers' that need no work.
#  bodies        FIRST-BLOCKER count on the CENSUS route (`IlBundle::census_functions`, the 4C 4F 11
#                NOT a distance and NOT a reach: the port stops at the first refusal by design, so
#                every blocked body reports exactly one key however many it has (#3131).
#  tus           distinct TUs in which the key heads at least one blocked body, of 878.
#  bodies_c1off  the same first-blocker count with `C2RS_OFF_ADD=off`, i.e. with C1 -- the ONE of the
#                ten that has SHIPPED -- de-admitted. See the rung section 6: three of the ten are
#                already in class on the census route, so their shipped head counts are RESIDUE.
# TU-DENOMINATED REACH, which is what #3509 was funded to produce:
#   TUs whose ENTIRE blocked-body head-key set lies inside the union of all ten: 0 of 845.
#   Same, per single construct: 0 of 845, for each of the ten.
#   Same, relaxing every byteless :eof/:mid/opt-mode key to free: 0 of 845 shipped, 1 of 845 with C1 off.
